gen-gf-paprika-gf-fragment-mono: Paprika is loud and scattered, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Fragment Mono lines up beside it like nails on a ruler, tall-waisted and precise, with no stroke contrast to slow the eye.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-geom: Geom brings a friendly, contemporary sans with a lofty lowercase band, sitting beneath Paprika and its scattered display letters. Pure, commanding presence up top is what makes this pair memorable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-jaldi: Paprika is commanding and expressive, with scattered letters and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Jaldi brings tightly brushed sans letters and a towering x-height, so paragraphs would read dense and quick.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-major-mono-display: Big, loud, and scattered: Paprika fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals. Major Mono Display brings wire-like monospace tubes of neon glass, so a full paragraph reads precise and technical.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-matemasie: Loud letters spread wide, lowercase filling the line like capitals, make Paprika unmistakable. Paprika is built to command attention, while Matemasie, with its broad gaps and low contrast, is built to read cleanly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads like magnified text at normal size, its weight unvarying from one word to the next. Paprika does the commanding best, while Saira does the quiet reading best.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Loud, scattered, and expressive: that is the whole look of Paprika. Sofia Sans Condensed reads plainly line after line, with a tall x-height, no hairline strokes, and curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-spline-sans-mono: Loud meets ruled: Paprika sprawls above while Spline Sans Mono lines up below in fixed-width, uniform strokes. Paprika earns its keep when it is big and the words are few.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-tiny5: Commanding up top, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that acts like capitals, while Tiny5 stays tall and clean beneath. Its ascenders look short because the whole body runs so tall.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-viga: Expressive up top, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that acts like capitals, while Viga stays plain sans below. Viga's hairline-free strokes stay out of the way, letting Paprika shout.
